name: pl-zerobg
title: Zero MRI Background
description: Set the background intensity of a MRI to 0

parameters.name: thresholds
parameters.help: A filename glob and background intensity threshold. Multiple pairs should be comma-separated, i.e. GLOB1:THRESHOLD1,GLOB2:THRESHOLD2,...

parameters.name: threads
parameters.help: Number of threads to use for parallel jobs. Pass 0 to use number of visible CPUs.
